newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: "Dead" Filipino man turns up at own wake.
newsitem.headline: "Dead" Filipino man turns up at own wake.

text.p: Isidro Catarla turned up at his own wake last weekend -- and probably regrets that he did.

Reported by his parents and wife to be missing since November 1, the 30-year-old was surprised on coming home to see his family and neighbours mourning beside a coffin containing what they thought was his corpse.
His picture rested on top of the casket.
His neighbours, more startled than he, fled on seeing Catarla walk into his house in the Manila district of Santa Ana.
Police sergeant Eliseo Victorio said the confusion arose when Catarla's parents and wife claimed from a funeral parlour the corpse of a drowned man thinking it was Catarla.
The dead man's facial features strikingly resembled those of Catarla.
Catarla went berserk on seeing his picture on top of the coffin.
But his troubles are not over. Now, police said, his neighbours are demanding that his family return the money they donated for his funeral.
Police said they wanted to question Catarla to find where he had been in the weeks he was missing.
